scope: Independent static review of the custody-resolution design, README, three JSON Schemas and unexecuted acceptance matrix. No executable collector, verifier or controller is included or certified.
source_freeze: Root explicitly declared the six design/contract sources frozen before sealing this review.

resolved_findings.issue: Availability floors did not specify process/Job memory caps; bootstrap startup floor scope needed clarification.
resolved_findings.resolution: Admission requires process_mib=4096 and job_mib=5120. Design lines180-190 identifies these as proposed bootstrap limits, explains the 10GiB default startup floor and preserves the separately scoped 4GiB amendment. Actual native enforcement remains an implementation prerequisite.

resolved_findings.issue: QPC start/end fields were unbounded integers despite the bounded-record claim.
resolved_findings.resolution: Boundary schema limits both to 0..9007199254740991. Mandatory verifier joins require finite/lossless parsing, explicit encoded-size/depth/node/string limits and calendar-valid UTC dates.

resolved_findings.issue: Attempt directory accepted malformed UUID layouts and minimum semantic joins were not explicit.
resolved_findings.resolution: Admission directory now uses the same UUID layout as operation_id. Mandatory verifier joins require exact final-segment equality, create-once consumption, independent review/hash bindings, temporal ordering/windows, QPC/host/boot consistency, normalized contained paths, fresh capture, resource and local-stop checks.

static_assessment.historical_failure_retained: Bootstrap004 remains FAILED_UNRELEASED_CONSUMED. Fixed disposition/audit/failure-review hashes remain pinned and custody_closed, operation_released and retry_allowed remain false.
static_assessment.unavailable_positive_proof: Original host/boot association is absent from the old packet and must be established independently with actual evidence. PID absence, a copied workspace, ordinary wall-clock boot time or acknowledgement alone cannot establish it.
static_assessment.provider_boundary: The complete-OS-restart path is a proposed semantic boundary only. Authoritative Windows-provider guarantees and actual runtime qualification remain prerequisites; insufficient evidence stays UNRESOLVED and the positive operational path stays disabled.
static_assessment.no_restart_claim: The design does not observe, request or authorize an automatic restart and does not claim a restart is currently necessary.
static_assessment.structural_contract: Schema records and nested objects are closed; required artifact references have finite path/byte/hash constraints. The disposition conditional requires a complete nonnull boundary and empty reasons for ELIGIBLE, otherwise null boundary and nonempty reasons. Structural conformity supplies no factual authentication or launch authority.
static_assessment.admission_trust_boundary: Disposition and boundary evidence have launch_authorized=false. A later Root one-operation admission is distinct and requires exact current joins, fresh entry checks, local stop, unused identity and independent review; accepted=true is not sufficient proof.
static_assessment.successor_invariants: Retained original handle and generation, unknown-Start state, sticky refusal, owned cleanup, bounded diagnostics, actual caller return, both EOFs, reap, closure and payload checks remain required. A successful metadata exit cannot release failed custody.
static_assessment.no_circular_bootstrap: Minimal observer/runtime dependencies require prior independent source review and finite local observation admission. Actual observation review must precede use by a different bootstrap operation.
static_assessment.limits: Explicit future-bootstrap time/output/memory/resource/thread/GPU limits are design requirements only; no current resource reading or enforced runtime limit is claimed.
static_assessment.completion_boundary: This accepted milestone is design and machine-readable contract sources only. Collector/verifier/controller implementation, independent implementation review, actual bounded validation and accepted operational disposition remain future work.

file_checks.method: Native file/text inspection, strict JSON parse with duplicate-property enumeration, local link existence, file lengths and SHA256. No JSON Schema validator, executable helper, project test, fixture test, Python or native/live process/provider query was run.
